entry.description: escape NUL characters in `EventLogAppender` content. `ReportEventW` takes a null terminated string, so a NUL in logged content ended the stored record there and silently dropped whatever the layout rendered after it, exception text and trailing fields included (CWE-158). `WriteEntry` raises nothing, so the record simply stored short. Measured on Windows 11 build 26200: of a 45 character message with a NUL at 23, the 23 character prefix was stored and the rest was gone (audit da18b6fd-f007)
